summary: Cetus Maritime Holdings Limited, an international shipping company, owns, operates, and manages dry bulk vessels. The company operates geared dry bulk vessels ranging from 13,000 to 70,000 dead weight tons. It provides chartering and technical management services, as well as transports a range of dry bulk commodities, including grains, agricultural products, bauxite, alumina, cement, aggregates, forest products, scrap, concentrates, fertilizers, ores, and others. The company operates in Hong Kong, Singapore, China, United Kingdom, United States, the Marshall Islands, Chile, Panama, Australia, Germany, and the British Virgin Islands. Cetus Maritime Holdings Limited was founded in 2004 and is based in Central, Hong Kong.
